dedupe_keys.name: meteor nepal seismic hazard map with mean peak ground acceleration pga in g for a 10 and 2 probability of exceedence in 50 years

description: The Global Earthquake Model Foundation publishes Nepal seismic-hazard values through the METEOR exposure project. Zenodo lists an open ZIP under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; its described CSV has latitude, longitude and mean peak ground acceleration for 10% and 2% exceedance probabilities in 50 years. The grid is 0.025 degrees in WGS84. These modelled intensities can drive earthquake exposure and damage scenarios for Nepalese roads, buildings or utilities. The related catalogue record data-meteor-nepal-landslide-hazard-maps covers landslides from the same project, not this shaking layer. This is a probabilistic map, not an observed earthquake time series. Its spatial detail may be too coarse for site design, and the underlying ground-motion assumptions need the cited hazard study. The file archive was not downloaded, so its internal row count and values were not checked.
